findings.title: Wednesday, October 21, 2026 Security Releases
findings.summary_md: The Node.js project shipped security releases in its 26.x, 24.x and 22.x lines, including Node.js v26.12.1, v24.22.1 and v22.23.4. CVE-2026-111497 is an out-of-bounds write in the bundled Brotli decoder reachable when an application decompresses attacker-supplied data with node:zlib: an invalid block switch was handled as a need for more input, so the streaming decoder kept appending bytes to an eight-byte internal buffer. The advisory credits OpenAI Codex Security researchers Khai Tran and Sylvie Mayer for reporting the flaw.

findings.title: Brotli: Out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder ("Node2Shell") also affects the PyPI Brotli package
findings.summary_md: GitHub's advisory database records CVE-2026-111497 as affecting the PyPI brotli and brotlicffi packages from 1.0.3 up to but not including 1.2.1, with fixes in 1.2.1 and 1.2.1.0. The underlying buffer overflow is in the Brotli decoder's c/dec/decode.c and can corrupt adjacent decoder state, disclose memory, cause a denial of service or permit code execution from a crafted compressed stream. It lists upstream fixes in Brotli 1.0.10, 1.1.1 and 1.2.1.

findings.title: oss-security: Brotli CVE-2026-111497 and git-remote-https
findings.summary_md: Harry Sintonen posted to oss-security on October 26, 2026 that git-remote-https is also affected by CVE-2026-111497 when libcurl is built with Brotli support, which he says is common in distributions. He noted that code using the older CURLOPT_ENCODING alias for CURLOPT_ACCEPT_ENCODING should be included when scanning other libcurl consumers. The post extends the known reach of the decoder bug beyond Node.js services.

findings.title: GreyNoise: first successful php2shell exploitation observed on October 28
findings.summary_md: GreyNoise reported that it observed the first successful exploitation of php2shell, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against a vulnerable sensor at 05:14:01 UTC on October 28, 2026. Andrew Thompson said roughly fifty differently configured servers can be vulnerable but the same exploit does not work across all of them, so actors must tailor exploits per configuration and mass exploitation is difficult. GreyNoise linked a live activity tracker with the post.

findings.title: Threat Brief: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP: CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619
findings.summary_md: Unit 42 describes both PHP2Shell CVEs as remote code execution flaws rated CVSS 4.0 9.2, one leaving request memory uninitialized after an out-of-memory longjmp and one leaving globals pointing at freed memory. It reported over 22.6 million potentially vulnerable instances in Cortex Xpanse telemetry at publication. An October 29 update says the bugs were actively exploited against internet-facing PAN-OS management interfaces, that Dream Research chained them with a Linux kernel privilege-escalation flaw for root, and that about 0.02% of the installed base had exposed management interfaces.

findings.title: PHP2Shell One Week Later: Honeypot Shells on the Web, a Path to Root on Palo Alto Firewalls
findings.summary_md: Hunt.io published an open-directory investigation on October 30, 2026 that found 616 PHP2Shell-related files, including shared exploit kits, cloned proofs of concept, scanners and post-exploitation tooling. It referred to earlier work mapping about 3.19 million internet-facing PHP hosts and identified a host at 130.94.67[.]235 serving a proof of concept that repackaged the PHP exploit chain for PAN-OS. The report also discusses the Dream Research chain with the Fragnesia kernel flaw, CVE-2026-46300, that obtained root on 25 servers.

findings.title: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Critical Java RCE Vulnerability Explained
findings.summary_md: Picus reports that OpenJDK published an advisory and Oracle shipped a patch for CVE-2026-114938 on November 17, 2026. The flaw is a heap out-of-bounds write in HotSpot's x86-64 Base64 decoder intrinsic, writing 62 bytes past the output buffer on CPUs with AVX-512 VBMI, with affected builds from OpenJDK 17.0.6 onward. Picus lists the temporary workarounds as disabling Base64 intrinsics or limiting AVX to level two until the JDK is patched.

findings.title: Security advisories: multiple vulnerabilities in Regexp and String case conversion
findings.summary_md: Ruby's advisory posted November 18, 2026 discloses seven vulnerabilities in the regular expression engine and string case conversion, with proofs of concept showing remote code execution in some scenarios. The fixes shipped in Ruby 4.0.10, 3.4.13 and 3.3.14. Among the issues is GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5, a one-byte heap overflow reached by changing the case of a crafted string.
